notes: THIS MOD HAS NO QUESTABLE CONTENT AT ALL. Not a judgement call and not an omission - InControl 9.4.7 for 1.20.1 Forge registers ZERO items, ZERO blocks and ZERO entities. VERIFICATION: the jar has 179 entries and NO assets/ directory whatsoever, so there is no lang file, no item model, no blockstate and therefore not a single translatable id in the incontrol namespace. The entire data/ tree is one file, data/incontrol/tags/blocks/cave_block.json, a block tag (#forge:stone, #forge:ores, cave vines, dripstone, calcite...) that the mod's own 'incave' rule test uses to decide whether a spawn position counts as a cave. Everything else in the jar is Java under mcjty/incontrol/ - rules/, spawner/, ai/, areas/, mob/, commands/, compat/. LOADER/VERSION CONFIRMED: META-INF/mods.toml (no fabric.mod.json), modId="incontrol", forge versionRange "[43.1.30,)", loaderVersion "[47,)"; the optional dependency is lostcities. WHAT THE MOD ACTUALLY IS: a spawn-RULES engine driven entirely by JSON config files the PACK AUTHOR writes into config/incontrol/ (spawn.json, summonaid.json, potentialspawn.json, loot.json, experience.json, phases.json, spawner.json). None of those ship in the jar - they are generated empty on first run - so there is nothing in this namespace a quest can name and nothing whose ordering could be researched. A pack that uses InControl expresses its progression through OTHER mods' mobs and items; InControl only decides where and when those spawn. CONSENSUS: absent from moddb.json, which is consistent with having no items rather than being a gap in the harvest. Do not generate a chapter for this mod; if the pack wants InControl visible to the player, the honest place for it is a single informational quest in another chapter, not a chain.
